reference: A. Yu. Kitaev, Phys.-Usp. 44, 131 (2001). A 1D p-wave superconductor hosts two Majorana operators, one at each end, that together make a single nonlocal fermion. They sit at zero energy, inside the gap, and are their own antiparticles. The plate is computed: the 2N × 2N Bogoliubov-de Gennes matrix of an open chain of N sites, one per column, is diagonalized exactly in double precision (Householder reduction and implicit QL, after Wilkinson and Reinsch, 1971), and each row is |u(x)|² + |v(x)|² of one ± pair of quasiparticle modes, scaled to its own peak, on a linear |E| axis from zero at the top.
equation: H = −μ Σ c†c − t Σ (c†_i c_{i+1}+h.c.) + Δ Σ (c_i c_{i+1}+h.c.),   |μ|<2t ⇒ unpaired γ_L, γ_R
limitations: Complete evidence covers the finite domain in validation/KITAEV.md: mean-field BdG Kitaev chains of 96 to 160 sites in the studio (the grids the tab allows), open in the tab and periodic or antiperiodic in the band check; shorter chains only in the Node tests of the module code.

Splittings below about 4Nε‖H‖ (1e-13 to 4e-13) are not resolved by double precision and are flagged; for most topological presets the exact splitting is far below that. An exact finite-N splitting is used only at Δ = t; elsewhere the rate and oscillation are tested, not the prefactor.
No self-consistent Δ, interactions, disorder, spin or nanowire experiment.
remaining: An exact finite-N splitting for general Δ (for example the closed forms of Leumer et al., J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 32, 445502, 2020) would turn the rate test into a value test.
Disorder and multi-band chains are outside this review.

numerical.scope: The module's own BdG matrix and exact diagonalization (Householder plus implicit QL), pairing rule and status measurements, extracted from the source: 72 periodic and antiperiodic rings against the exact band, 1492 open chains against the winding criterion with the exact bulk gap, the splitting decay for six parameter sets, the Δ = t SSH identity on 773 chains, the Majorana profile, and an independent Jacobi solver on a separately built matrix.
numerical.criteria: Ring eigenvalues within 1e-12 of ±sqrt((2t cos k + μ)² + 4Δ² sin² k) on k = 2πm/N or 2π(m+½)/N, residual and orthonormality < 1e-12; in-gap count = 2 × winding at every tested point; split / (max|x±|^N, times |sin((N+1)θ)| for complex roots) constant to 1e-3 relative with drift below 1e-4 per site; at Δ = t, splitting within 4Nε‖H‖ of twice the SSH edge root; |u| = |v|, profile and pair density within 1e-9 + 4 max|x±|^N of the closed form; Jacobi eigenvalues within 1e-11 and field within 1e-6; every failure control fails.
numerical.benchmark: Exact BdG band of the ring; closed-form bulk gap; numerically computed winding of (−μ − 2t cos k, 2Δ sin k); closed-form Majorana roots x± of (t + Δ)x² + μx + (t − Δ) = 0 and profile φ_j (A. Yu. Kitaev, Phys.-Usp. 44, 131, 2001); exact SSH edge root at Δ = t (Majorana chain with v = |μ|, w = 2t); independent Float64 Jacobi diagonalization of a BdG matrix built in the interleaved Nambu basis.
numerical.failureControl: Injected into copies of the module: pairing Δ dropped (band off by up to 1.5, 38 of 46 criterion points disagree); ring closed with the opposite boundary sign (band off by 0.087); open chain given a closing bond (all 38 topological points lose the pair); one QL eigenvector rotation dropped (residual 2.0, profile fails). All must fail and do.
numerical.limitations: Finite chains only; unresolved splittings are flagged, not measured; mean-field BdG only.

print.scope: Seven studio recipes (the presets, all four sheets, every allowed grid 96 to 160, both views) in a temporary copy of dist/studio.html: plate field, status numbers and the module's exportPNG at 300 ppi sheet sizes.
print.criteria: Browser field identical bit for bit to the extracted code and within 1e-6 of the Jacobi field; status prints the measured end weight and splitting; every exported pixel within one channel level of its nearest-neighbor cell (a neighboring cell on boundaries), none unmatched; a one-cell displacement mismatches more than 1% of pixels; recipe and plate state unchanged by export.
print.benchmark: Colors rebuilt in the page from the independently checked field through the shared ramp and the stated paint formula (each row scaled to its own peak).
print.failureControl: Displaced-print comparison (one cell in x or y) must mismatch; the numerical failure controls change the field and would fail the field equality.
print.limitations: Raster density plate; no vector output. Chromium with SwiftShader only.

domain.parameters: Rings: N = 64, 96, 160 with twelve (μ, t, Δ). Open: μ −2.40 to 2.40 (step 0.05) × t ∈ {0.4, 1, 1.6} × Δ ∈ {0.05, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 1.1, 1.4} at N = 64; splitting N = 4 to the largest N above 1000 floors (97 at most) for six sets; Δ = t identity N = 3 to 160; seven studio recipes listed in validation/results/kitaev-science.json.
domain.conditions: Spinless mean-field BdG Kitaev chain with real μ, t, Δ; open ends in the tab, periodic and antiperiodic rings in the band check; no disorder or self-consistency; no randomness; exports preserve the state.
domain.resolution: Exact diagonalization of the 2N × 2N BdG matrix; eigenvalues to about 1e-14 absolute; splittings below 4Nε‖H‖ unresolved and flagged. Print sheets 2400 × 2400, 1920 × 2400, 2400 × 1920, 2400 × 1350.
domain.precision: Binary64 solver and references; Float32 plate field; RGBA8 raster; Chromium and Node versions recorded.
